import csv
tsid = "108335ab-9ad0-5222-b9a5-88d998152c65"
rows = []
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        if row["timeseries_id"] == tsid and row["timestamp"].startswith("2018-10-25"):
            rows.append((row["timestamp"], float(row["value"])))
rows.sort()
print(len(rows))
for t,v in rows:
    print(t, v)
print("max", max(v for _,v in rows))
print("all <=26", all(v <= 26 for _,v in rows))
